subject: a Kurdish Muslim sultan of the 12th century with a neat dark beard, a white turban wrapped around a pointed cap, a long dark kaftan with a simple sash and a sheathed curved sword, calm thoughtful eyes, modest dress

panels.01-tikrit: a family on horseback and camels leaving a mud-brick fortress town on a cliff above the Tigris river at night under a crescent moon, lanterns, Mesopotamia 1137, wide establishing shot
panels.02-vizier: a young {S} standing in a columned Fatimid palace hall in Cairo in 1169, being received as vizier by courtiers in silk robes, carved wooden screens, oil lamps, dignified
panels.03-damascus: {S} riding at the head of a column of horsemen through the great gate of medieval Damascus in 1174, citizens watching from rooftops, the minaret of the Umayyad Mosque behind, peaceful entry
panels.04-citadel: {S} on a rocky hill above Cairo in 1176 looking over plans with an engineer while workers cut stone blocks for a great fortress wall, the Nile and the city in the distance, golden light
panels.05-hattin: {S} on horseback on a dry hill at dawn in July 1187, watching smoke drifting across a parched valley below two rocky hills, officers beside him pointing to a map, strategy and tension, no fighting shown
panels.06-jerusalem: {S} meeting a Crusader nobleman in chain mail and a white surcoat outside the walls of Jerusalem in 1187, both standing respectfully as they negotiate terms, the city walls and Dome of the Rock in the background, calm and solemn
panels.07-mother: {S} on horseback in a military camp handing a small swaddled baby back to a kneeling Frankish woman in a medieval European dress and veil, soldiers and an attendant looking on with emotion, 1190, compassion
panels.08-truce: two envoys, one Muslim in a turban and robes and one Frankish knight in a surcoat, exchanging a sealed treaty scroll inside a large tent in 1192, {S} seated and listening calmly, the sea visible through the tent opening, peace
